title: Humantime
description: A joke-ish addon for Gravestone: Herotime that adds a human transformation
body:
Humantime is a gravepack for Gravestone: Herotime

I made Humantime mainly as a joke, it adds a Human transformation to the watch, which would normally be useless

UNLESS!!

you have another Palladium addon that Herotime may dampen powers for while transformed (for example, FSang18's Heropack) and you want to go from a Kryptonian to a Human! (for whatever reason)

have fun with it :3
